VehicleMetadata.purpose: Flexible catalogue documents holding inspection history and dynamic per-vehicle features.

field_notes.vehicle_id: int, unique. Matches vehicles.id in PostgreSQL.
field_notes.features: object, open-ended. New feature keys can appear without a migration.

sample_document.comment: Smooth ride, driver took the flyover route.

field_notes.rating: int, 1-5 inclusive. Enforced by the validator so the Workflow 4 histogram can never gain a sixth bucket.
field_notes.feedback_tags: array of strings. $unwind in Workflow 4 expands this, so it must always be an array, never a bare string.
field_notes.city: string. Equality predicate of the Workflow 4 $match, and the leading field of idx_reviews_city_created_at.
field_notes.created_at: BSON Date, never a string. The Workflow 4 $match compares it against a Date; a string field would silently match nothing.

TelemetryPings.purpose: High-volume GPS location log emitted by active vehicles.

field_notes.location: GeoJSON Point. coordinates is [longitude, latitude] - longitude FIRST. Reversed pairs either fail validation when latitude exceeds 90 or, worse, index a valid but wrong point on the globe.
field_notes.is_available: bool. Workflow 3 filters on this inside its $geoNear query predicate, so it must be present on every ping.
field_notes.created_at: BSON Date. Carries the 7200-second TTL index; a string here would build the index fine and then never expire anything.

TripReviews.why: Backs the $match that precedes $facet in Workflow 4. Equality field first, range field second.

TelemetryPings.why: Required by $geoNear in Workflow 3. Returns distances in metres.
Raw telemetry is only useful live, so it self-deletes after two hours instead of growing without bound.
